Does this text message actually offer that CO will call THEM — Cue proposing to place an outbound call to the person, not just telling them how they can call Cue themselves — in any wording, even indirectly (e.g. "I'm here if you want to talk this through")? Not just related to talking or listening in general — specifically Cue offering to call them.

Message: "That's not a resume line, that's the actual reason. Ten years of making margins better for companies that didn't need the help, while the person who grew the thing got the smallest piece of it.

Food supply chains is a big label though. Is it the part where farmers get squeezed on price, the waste between farm and table, or something closer to what his actual experience was?"

Return ONLY "yes" or "no".
